For questions around nx configuration, best practices or if you're unsure, use the `nx_docs` tool to get relevant, up-to-date docs. Always use this instead of assuming things about nx configuration

Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript strict, Supabase, TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest; Czech club-management system. UI language is **Czech** — all user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Use these skills **without being asked** when applicable:
`/new-entity` — use proactively whenever the user asks to add a new database table, data model, or CRUD feature. Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.
`/db-sync` — use proactively after any DB migration is applied or when TypeScript types are out of sync with the database schema.
`/new-migration` — use proactively whenever a new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy needs to be created in the database.
`/generate-barrels` — use proactively after adding, renaming, or removing any hook, component, type, or enum file. Run before committing.
`/review-pr` — use when the user asks for a code review, PR review, or "check my changes".
Follow these patterns strictly. Do not deviate without explicit user instruction.

Entity layout:
`src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (AUTO-GENERATED, do not edit manually); `data/{camelCase}.ts` (domain types extending schema).
`src/queries/{pluralCamel}/constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY), `queries.ts` (read; QueryContext), `mutations.ts` (write; QueryContext), `index.ts` (barrel).
`src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts` (createDataFetchHook factory), `state/use{Entity}.ts` (createCRUDHook factory).
Translations: `src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts`.

Client: `supabaseBrowserClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/client`; server: `supabaseServerClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/server`; authenticated API: `withAuth(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers`; admin: `withAdminAuth(handler)`; public: `withPublicAccess(handler)`. Coach checks: `hasCoachRole()` / `isAdmin()` / `checkCoachCardAccess()` from `@/utils/supabase/coachAuth` — these are **auth helpers, not clients**.
Never import a server client in a client component or vice versa.
Prefer `apiHelpers` wrappers over calling `supabaseServerClient()` directly in API routes — they handle auth, 401/403, and error responses consistently.
All query/mutation functions in `src/queries/` receive `ctx: QueryContext` as first argument and use `ctx.supabase`. Never call the Supabase client directly inside query files.

These files are **auto-generated** — never edit manually, always regenerate:
`src/hooks/index.ts`, `src/types/index.ts`, `src/components/index.ts`.
These files are **manual** — always update by hand:
`src/lib/api-routes.ts`, `src/lib/translations/index.ts`.

Barrel opt-out: add `// <REDACTED_USER>` within the first 5 lines of a `.ts`/`.tsx` file, or add an empty `.barrel-ignore` in the folder (e.g. `SomeComponent/utils/.barrel-ignore`). Use for non-public utility/helper files. Generator: `scripts/generate-component-exports.mjs`.

Use `Grid`, `GridItem`, `HStack`, and `VStack` from `@/components` instead of raw Tailwind flex/grid classes. **Important:** Tailwind CSS does not support dynamic class construction (e.g. `` `flex-${direction}` ``). All layout components use static lookup maps to generate classes. Follow this pattern when creating new layout components.
Grid files: `src/components/ui/Grid/Grid.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Grid/components/GridItem.tsx`; stack files: `src/components/ui/HStack/HStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/VStack/VStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Stack/Stack.tsx` (base).
Use `<Grid columns={1-6} gap="sm|md|lg|xl">`, `
